peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 7% below its local comparables; 33 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (35.6): 4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 38 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,430,000 ($1,498 psf, 947–990 sq ft; 10 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,600 psf (range $1,478–1,672); 6.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $97,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,930,000 ($1,548 psf, 1,227–1,345 sq ft; 13 resales, Jul 2025–Jun 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,677 psf (range $1,466–1,751); 7.7% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $161,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tanah Merah MRT about 160 m, Bedok Reservoir MRT about 1,610 m; closer than 100 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest ST. Anthony's Canossian Primary School about 840 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 360 m), more than 81 of 116 similar developments (the same as 17); nearest hawker centre New Upper Changi Road Blk 58 about 690 m; nearest park Bedok Town Park about 1,600 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 70 m; Bagnall Haus, 11 new sales, about 1,400 m; Pinery Residences, 552 new sales, about 1,840 m; Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 67 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,508 new sales and 671 resales (2,179 purchases); new sales were 69.2% of these purchases. Subsales (23) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 280 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 671 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 104 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 671 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 772 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.1%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
